caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device set on a flat, rectangular, wood-grained base with rounded front edges. At the left side of the base are two vertical posts, each with carved detailing and a square profile, supporting a horizontally oriented cylindrical rod. Attached to the left end of this rod is a hand crank with a handle. The cylindrical rod runs parallel to the width of the base, extending rightward where it supports a fork-like pronged attachment followed by a spiral or helical piece. A turned wooden handle is attached to this helical piece. Toward the right edge of the base, there is an angled support bracket with a metal rod extending horizontally to the fork and spiral assembly. The entire apparatus is rendered in various shades of brown, with visible wood grain and metal details painted in mid-grey tones, all set against a plain, off-white background. There is a small area of text visible in the bottom right quadrant of the image.
title: Apple Peeler
